title: hep-simkernels: Geant4-matched particle-matter kernels for fast simulation
description: hep-simkernels re-implements named Geant4 11.3.2 electromagnetic models for fast simulation: muon energy loss with fluctuations, electron ionisation, multiple scattering, Seltzer-Berger bremsstrahlung, positron annihilation, muon radiative losses, slab propagation and straight-line transport through GDML geometry. Each kernel has a NumPy reference and, where it runs on a device, a JAX twin in float32 and float64; NIST materials and experiment hooks keep the package experiment-neutral. Compact copies of the Geant4 Seltzer-Berger and Mott data travel with it under the Geant4 Software License.
references: Agostinelli, S. et al., "Geant4 - a simulation toolkit", Nuclear Instruments and Methods in Physics Research Section A 506 (2003) 250, doi:10.1016/S0168-9002(03)01368-8
Allison, J. et al., "Geant4 developments and applications", IEEE Transactions on Nuclear Science 53 (2006) 270, doi:10.1109/TNS.2006.869826
Allison, J. et al., "Recent developments in Geant4", Nuclear Instruments and Methods in Physics Research Section A 835 (2016) 186, doi:10.1016/j.nima.2016.06.125
notes: Bundles compact copies of G4EMLOW 8.6.1 brem_SB and the G4MottData coefficients of Geant4 11.3.2, distributed under the Geant4 Software License (https://geant4.web.cern.ch/license); see NOTICE.
